item_short_desc: Rothco’s Military Trauma Kit Contents feature over 200 essential first aid items.
description: Rothco’s Military Trauma Kit Contents have the same items as our Military Trauma Kit and EMT Medical Trauma Kit (item #1105 and 1145). Featuring over 200 essential first aid items; including a variety of bandages, medical instruments, and a blood pressure cuff kit. The trauma kit is a great way to replenish your emergency supplies when needed.
